This role will lead and coordinate communications for a portfolio of complex change programmes and projects, helping staff and stakeholders understand and engage with institutional change. UCSO provides expertise in change and communications, benefits realisation, portfolio planning, common standards, strategic reporting and business-case appraisal. It supports the Change and Programme Management Board in directing and overseeing the University's portfolio of major change programmes, for which communications is a key enabling function. Working within the strategic communications direction and the established operational priorities, the post-holder will develop, implement and evaluate communications approaches for UCSO-supported change activity. The role will provide specialist advice on stakeholder engagement, messaging, timing, channels, listening mechanisms and communications risks, including where issues are sensitive or operationally significant. The post-holder will also serve as the UCSO communications practice lead for change activity, developing standards, tools and templates; coordinating communications across programmes; coaching contributors; and using audience insight and feedback to improve communications impact. The role will work closely with programme teams, Change Partners, communications colleagues and the University's Internal Communications Team within the Office of External Affairs and Communications. Key responsibilities Develop, implement and evaluate internal communications strategies and stakeholder engagement plans for UCSO-supported change activity, translating programme objectives into clear messages, channels, listening arrangements and impact measures. Provide specialist communications advice to programme boards, senior responsible officers, committees, managers and programme teams on sensitive messaging, timing, stakeholder confidence, reputational considerations and adoption risks. Define and embed communications standards, tools, templates and quality criteria, and support consistent practice across programmes through coaching, feedback and practical guidance. Coordinate communications across UCSO-supported programmes, Reimagining Professional Service activity and other major change initiatives, aligning messages and schedules and resolving duplication or conflicting communications needs. Produce, commission, edit and assure high-quality communications products, and use audience insight, channel information and stakeholder feedback to identify risks and improve communications effectiveness. About you You will: Have significant experience of leading or coordinating communications for complex organisational change, transformation, policy implementation or institutional programmes involving multiple stakeholder groups. Bring advanced knowledge of internal and change communications, with experience of advising senior stakeholders on sensitive communications, engagement, messaging, timing and reputational considerations. Have excellent written, verbal and editorial judgement and experience of producing or assuring high-impact content for specialist and non-specialist audiences. Be able to develop practical communications strategies, standards and evaluation approaches, interpret audience insight and feedback, and influence effectively through matrix working arrangements. Be educated to degree level, or have equivalent practical experience, in communications, engagement, public relations, journalism, marketing, organisational change or a related field. A recognised professional communications qualification is desirable. The Benefits In return, you will receive an extensive reward and benefits package including: 41 days annual leave, including bank holidays. Potential for flexible and hybrid working, subject to the operational needs of the role. A generous pension scheme, discount portal, cycle to work scheme, access to the University accommodation service, relocation expenses scheme, employee assistance programme and family-friendly policies. The funds for this post are available for 3 years in the first instance. Applications are welcome from internal candidates who would like to apply for the role on the basis of a secondment from their current role in the University. We welcome applications from individuals who wish to be considered for part-time working or other flexible working arrangements. monzo bank ltd|london.description:
🚀 We’re on a mission to make money work for everyone.

We’re waving goodbye to the complicated and confusing ways of traditional banking.

After starting as a prepaid card, our product offering has grown a lot in the last 10 years in the UK. As well as personal and business bank accounts, we offer joint accounts, accounts for 16-17 year olds, a free kids account and credit cards in the UK, with more exciting things to come beyond. Our UK customers can also save, invest and combine their pensions with us. 

With our hot coral cards and get-paid-early feature, combined with financial education on social media and our award winning customer service, we have a long history of creating magical moments for our customers!

We’re not about selling products - we want to solve problems and change lives through Monzo ❤️

 

📍London OR UK Remote | 💰 £95,000 - £115,000 + Benefits | Hear from the team ✨ 

💼 The Team

If you love driving ambitious PR strategies, across multiple European markets outside of the UK and are passionate about what Monzo is doing, this could be the role for you! We're looking for an experienced PR professional to join our team as a Senior PR and Communications Manager (12 month fixed term contract) for Expansion Markets to help us bring Monzo to more people in more places.

You will have strong experience managing successful PR activities and campaigns in markets beyond the UK. You’ll have the ability to run the day-to-day PR activity in already established markets whilst also planning and executing PR launches in brand new markets and supporting in-market leadership profiling. 

In this role, you will work closely with multiple teams including marketing, social, influencer, product and Monzo’s leadership team. You’ll devise and execute PR strategies that support business goals and showcase the best of Monzo in other markets. You'll need the ability to multitask managing multiple campaigns and market launches at the same time as well as having exceptional stakeholder management and collaboration skills.

This role is for a strategic planner and doer, you can see the big picture but are not afraid to get your hands dirty and approach projects in a collaborative manner. 

You'll report to the Director of Corporate Communications and will manage an EU PR Manager based in Spain.

🔑You’ll play a key role by…

  • Planning and executing all PR activity in already established European markets, Ireland and Spain.
  • Leading and implementing our go-to-market PR strategy for Monzo in all new markets across EU. This includes establishing resources, building a launch plan and running the day-to-day. 
  • Finding creative ways to get Monzo regularly into consumer press through big campaigns and smaller reactive, locally relevant news jumps. 
  • Balance global campaigns with localised stories to ensure consistency and locally relevant content.
  • Managing spokespeople and acting as a strategic advisor to senior leaders on external communications, media training, engagement, and storytelling.
  • Collaborating cross-functionally with product, commercial, and operations teams to uncover and amplify compelling PR opportunities.
  • Managing current international agencies and team members whilst also resourcing and setting us up for success in new EU markets. 
  • Building strong relationships with key media and journalists, while managing incoming press enquiries.
  • Using data and insights to inform and adapt strategy for our international expansion efforts.
  • Establishing new processes and ways of working in new markets. 
  • Staying ahead of industry and relevant policy trends and developments to inform strategy and maintain thought leadership.

🤩 We’d love to hear from you if you have…

  • Proven experience leading both tailored and scalable PR strategies for multiple international markets.
  • Experience launching brands with little brand awareness in new markets across Europe.
  • A track record of building and managing high-performing teams.
  • Strong experience working with and managing external agencies across multiple markets.
  • Ability to understand local media, audience nuances and adapt strategy based on this. 
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments.
  • Ability to demonstrate creativity and impact in delivering standout PR campaigns.
  • Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • A genuine passion for Monzo’s mission and an excitement to help bring it to more customers around the world!

 

🙌 What’s in it for you

💰 £95,000 - £115,000 

📍 This role can be based in our London or Cardiff office, or distributed working within the UK (with meetings in London and potential international travel).

⏰ We offer flexible working hours and trust you to work enough hours to do your job well, and at times that suit you and your team.

📚 Substantial learning budget each year for executive development, conferences, and industry engagements.

🏡 We will set you up to work from home; all employees are given Macbooks and for fully remote workers we will provide comprehensive support for your work-from-home setup.

➕ Plus lots more! Read our full list of benefits.

🌈 The application journey has 4 key steps

  • Phone call with Recruiter (30 mins)
  • Video interview with team member (30 mins)
  • Technical & behavioural video interview (60 mins)
  • Leadership final (30 mins)

Our average process takes around 3–4 weeks, but we will always work around your availability.

We’ll only close this role once we have enough applications for the next stage. Please submit your application as soon as possible to make sure you don’t miss out.

At Monzo, we’re embracing diversity by fostering an inclusive environment for all people to do the best work of their lives with us. This is integral to our mission of making money work for everyone. You can read more in our blog, 2026 Diversity and Inclusion Report and 2025 Gender Pay Gap Report.

We’re looking for several Product Marketing Leads to set the market intelligence and product strategy for individual product Collectives.

At Monzo, Product Marketing is a global product-market fit discipline rather than a GTM discipline. We’re embedded in squads with PMs, Designers and User Researchers, shaping products and propositions by acting as the voice of the market (UK, Ireland, Spain and future markets). We then partner closely with Integrated Marketing, who lead marketing strategy and execution, to bring those propositions to customers. Together, we aim to build and market category-leading products. If that’s your flavour of product marketing, Monzo is for you.

This is a player/coach role. You'll own Product Marketing for a Collective: understanding customers, shaping product strategy, defining positioning, and guiding how launches land in the market. If you love influencing what gets built as much as how it's communicated, you'll feel at home here.

Where you could join:

  • Wealth is building the future of how people grow their money: helping millions of customers save, invest, and plan for retirement with the same simplicity and trust they expect from their current account. It spans Savings, Investments, Pensions, Insurance, and brand new kinds of wealth-building experiences. This is a role for someone who wants to challenge how traditional wealth products work to make growing money (finally) feel simpler and more useful for everyday customers.
  • MonzOS is the intelligence layer of Monzo: an AI-powered operating system that helps customers find the right product, insight or action at the right moment. It brings together personalisation, recommendations, search and in-app discovery to make Monzo feel more useful every time someone opens the app. This is a role for someone who is excited by the challenge of making Monzo feel simple, trusted and indispensable in people’s financial lives.
  • EU is building Monzo for millions of customers across Europe, taking what people love about Monzo in the UK and making it work brilliantly in new markets. This role will lead consumer market insight and competitor discovery for new countries, while supporting growth in already-live markets like Ireland and Spain. This is a role for someone who loves figuring out how to win a market: turning customer insight, competitor analysis and local context into practical, provocative choices for product and marketing.

Key Responsibilities

You and your team will…

  • Set strategy for multiple categories. You'll own a one-year product marketing strategy for a complex, multi-product Collective. You will work to define how Monzo wins in multiple categories with multiple products over time.
  • Set the market intelligence agenda. You'll decide what we need to understand about our customers, competitors, and the market. You’ll identify and size opportunities, and build the frameworks other teams use to prioritise and respond.
  • Shape what gets built. You'll use market intelligence to shape product strategy across multiple areas, bringing a perspective that changes what we build and in what order. You'll sit alongside Product leadership, driving commercial outcomes through product differentiation.
  • Define positioning that moves the business. You'll ensure every product starts with a customer problem, differentiated positioning, and a proposition worth talking about. You’ll demonstrate that positioning will shift customer perception and move revenue at scale.
  • Own how we go to market. You'll decide when products launch, with what mechanic, and in what order, so launches across the Collective add up to more than a run of releases. You'll give Integrated Marketing a brief sharp enough that they never have to guess, then feed what the market tells you back into the proposition.
  • Raise the bar for Product Marketing. You'll define what great looks like through high standards, coaching, feedback, and better systems. You'll improve how PMM works by embedding AI into our workflows, tools, and playbooks. On the manager track, you'll also be accountable for the development, performance, and careers of a small team.

Great PMMs come from all sorts of places. This is for you if: 

  • You think beyond a single product. You're comfortable owning strategy across multiple products and categories, where work spans multiple squads and the decisions have business-wide implications.
  • You own the hardest calls in your domain. You're trusted to make high-stakes positioning and strategy decisions independently, and you're right often enough that Product and Marketing leadership seek your judgement. You're comfortable making difficult trade-offs between commercial needs, customer experience, and competitive urgency when the right answer isn't obvious.
  • You bring senior people with you. You build consensus around difficult decisions, influence senior stakeholders across disciplines, and create clarity out of ambiguity. People look to you for guidance when the path forward isn't obvious.
  • You're a player/coach. You still want to do the hardest strategic work yourself while coaching others through feedback, mentoring, and high standards. Whether or not you're a people manager, your impact is visible in the growth of the people around you.

The Interview Process

Our interview process involves three main stages:

  • Initial Call (45mins) 
  • Case Study Presentation (1hour)
  • x2 final interviews via Google Meet (45mins for each interview)

This process should take around 3-4 weeks - your schedule is really important to us, so we promise to be as flexible as possible!

This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys hands-on campaign execution, working across multiple channels and markets, and using data to continually test, learn and improve performance.

  • Support the end-to-end delivery of activity across our European markets, from campaign planning and set up through to optimisation, measurement and reporting
  • Take a leading role in delivering and optimising our Direct Mail activity, including audience selection, campaign planning, creative development, supplier coordination, testing and performance analysis
  • Support campaign execution across Paid Social and Paid Search, working closely with our channel managers to launch and optimise activity
  • Help develop testing strategies around account structure, campaign planning, experiments, and creative roadmaps
  • Work closely with local market teams and our Brand, Integrated Marketing, Creative, Product and Data teams to deliver campaigns that are locally relevant and grounded in customer insight
  • Share learnings across the wider Growth Marketing team, helping us build repeatable playbooks for launching Monzo Business in new markets

This is for you if:

  • You put the customer first. We’re a mission-led company and everything we do is to benefit our customers
  • You take a ‘test and learn’ approach and love agile ways of working
  • You have experience delivering Direct Mail campaigns, ideally within an acquisition or growth marketing environment
  • You have experience across, or are curious to expand your skills into, other performance channels such as Paid Social and Paid Search
  • You like to use data to tell a story about performance and understand how our business customers engage with us
  • You’re highly organised and enjoy getting campaigns from idea through to execution, coordinating across different teams and partners

  • Own the New Verticals specific ads and monetization strategy across owned and external surfaces, feeding into the global monetization strategy.

  • Own and evolve the New Verticals merchant marketing playbook, setting how co marketing, promotions, and advertising work for grocery and retail merchants globally.

  • Lead change initiatives that improve how New Verticals merchant marketing works, bringing Local Integrated Marketing and Functional Marketing along with you.

Key Merchant Relationship Management

  • Support local marketing teams with key enterprise merchant relationships at the global level, and support delivery of priority New Verticals marketing initiatives with those merchants.

  • Act as the senior escalation point for merchant issues that cross multiple markets or functions.

Cross Functional Stakeholder Management

  • Serve as the primary marketing partner to Merchant S&O and Commercial for New Verticals, translating category priorities into marketing and ads strategy.

  • Represent New Verticals in cross functional forums, shaping the roadmap for merchant facing and ads facing surfaces.

Sell In Strategy & Sales Enablement

  • Own the sell-in strategy for New Verticals merchant and ads programmes, defining how Commercial and Local teams pitch these programmes to merchants.

  • Oversee the sell in materials, case studies, and proof points for New Verticals, using performance data to continuously refine them.

Central Strategy & Market Coordination

  • Own delivery of the New Verticals merchant marketing goals, coordinating a consistent strategy across all Deliveroo markets.

  • Report on New Verticals merchant and ads marketing performance to senior stakeholders, own specific business metrics, and lead course correction when needed.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of marketing experience, ideally including merchant marketing, retail media, ads, or category marketing in a consumer or marketplace business.

  • Track record of owning the marketing strategy for an entire team or category, and resolving complex delivery challenges that span multiple teams or functions.

  • Experience managing people, and comfortable managing other people managers as your team grows.

  • Strong commercial acumen, seen as a go to expert for merchant or ads marketing, using business and financial data to make sound decisions in ambiguous situations.

  • Confident communicator, able to present complex ideas to large groups and flex your style for directors and department leadership.

  • Skilled at establishing and owning cross functional partnerships, using relationships and creative thinking to work through conflict.

  • Proven ability to lead change initiatives that improve how a team or category works, bringing others along with you.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to synthesise complex, cross functional inputs into a clear plan and narrative.

🔧 Make a visible impact every day

Your work directly improves experiences for customers, partners and riders.

🌱 Learn fast in an entrepreneurial environment

Work close to the market with autonomy, pace and real responsibility.

🧠 Build a career, not just a role

Stretch yourself, develop new skills and grow as the business evolves.

🌎 Deliver together in an inclusive culture

Collaborative, values-driven teams that support how you work best.

We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire here.

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.
